title: Report Review Protocol and Validation Disposition Governance
phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
repairTrigger: WC08 validation exposed a report-template and review-protocol defect: validation reports ask the Operator to select workflow disposition and do not embed stable Architect review rules; Implementer Reports also lack consistent embedded Architect review instructions.
primaryObjective: Repair the report-template and review-protocol system so validation reports and Implementer Reports contain embedded Architect review instructions and no longer force the Operator to make workflow disposition decisions.

carriedForwardObservations.summary: Validation and Implementer reports lack embedded Architect review instructions, and Operator Decision in validation reports creates role confusion.

requiredImplementation: Remove or deprecate Operator Decision as final routing authority in new validation reports.
Add Architect Disposition Pending to validation reports.
Add field semantics and Architect Review Instructions to validation reports.
Support Pass with concerns or equivalent non-blocking concern state.
Treat legacy operatorDecision as advisory, not final disposition.
Add Architect Review Instructions to Implementer Reports.
Require Operator validation steps when an implementation is ready for Operator validation.
Preserve existing workflow behavior outside report-template/report-protocol scope.
outOfScope: Do not implement WC08-REPAIR01 route-context explanation changes in this pass.
Do not redesign the entire validation screen beyond required report-template/report-field changes.
